FIELD.NAME: targetretention
FIELD.COMMENT: Retrievability at which an item becomes due. Lower means fewer reviews and more forgetting.

FIELD.NAME: sessionsize
FIELD.COMMENT: Maximum items offered in one session.

FIELD.NAME: newperday
FIELD.COMMENT: Cap on new items introduced per day, so an eager learner is not buried in reviews a week later.

FIELD.NAME: unlockmode
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 time based, 1 mastery based.

FIELD.NAME: unlockinterval
FIELD.COMMENT: Days between band unlocks in time based mode.

FIELD.NAME: stabilityfloor
FIELD.COMMENT: Stability in days at which an item counts as established, in mastery mode.

FIELD.NAME: masteryproportion
FIELD.COMMENT: Share of a band that must be established before the next unlocks.

FIELD.NAME: backstopdays
FIELD.COMMENT: Maximum effective days on one band before it unlocks regardless.

FIELD.NAME: coursestart
FIELD.COMMENT: Course wide start of week one. Week boundaries are the same for every learner.

FIELD.NAME: gracebalance
FIELD.COMMENT: Grace credit granted up front, as a fraction of weeks.

FIELD.NAME: graceearnrate
FIELD.COMMENT: Grace earned per session worth of voluntary work during a suspension window.

FIELD.NAME: passthreshold
FIELD.COMMENT: Partial credit at or above this counts as recall rather than a lapse.

FIELD.NAME: uselatency
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether answer latency may refine a correct answer from good to easy.

FIELD.NAME: audiocue
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the audio feedback cue is on by default.

FIELD.NAME: pausecorrect
FIELD.COMMENT: Milliseconds of feedback before auto advancing after a correct answer.

FIELD.NAME: pauseincorrect
FIELD.COMMENT: Milliseconds of feedback after an incorrect answer. Longer, because there is more to take in.

FIELD.NAME: completionweeks
FIELD.COMMENT: Custom completion rule: weeks the learner must clear. Zero disables the rule.

FIELD.NAME: questionbankcmid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course module id of the question bank whose categories the settings form offers. Zero means every bank the course can reach.

FIELD.NAME: ontimegrace
FIELD.COMMENT: Most grace a learner can earn by answering items when they fall due rather than late. Zero switches the reward off.

FIELD.NAME: maxchoices
FIELD.COMMENT: Most answer options to present for a multiple choice question, counting the right one. Surplus wrong options are dropped at random. Zero presents every option.

TABLE.NAME: rememberme_schedule
TABLE.COMMENT: Per learner, per item memory state. Stability and difficulty are authoritative; the interval is never stored, only derived.

FIELD.NAME: questionbankentryid
FIELD.COMMENT: The stable bank entry, not a versioned question id, so editing a question does not orphan the learner's memory state.

FIELD.NAME: stability
FIELD.COMMENT: Days at which retrievability decays to the target retention.

FIELD.NAME: difficulty
FIELD.COMMENT: Intrinsic hardness of this item for this learner, 1 to 10.

FIELD.NAME: fuzzfactor
FIELD.COMMENT: Stored jitter multiplier. The interval stays derivable from stability while the schedule stays reproducible.

FIELD.NAME: state
FIELD.COMMENT: new, learning, review or relearning.

FIELD.NAME: bandlevel
FIELD.COMMENT: Band this item was introduced from. Review is never band restricted; this is for reporting.

FIELD.NAME: duedate
FIELD.COMMENT: Cached wall clock due date, suspension aware at write time. The authoritative test is effective elapsed time; this exists so the hot query can use an index.

FIELD.NAME: learningdue
FIELD.COMMENT: While non zero the item is in a short learning step after a wrong answer and returns at this moment, rather than at the interval its stability implies. Cleared once the item is answered correctly.

INDEX.NAME: rememberme-userid-duedate
INDEX.COMMENT: The hot query path: what is due for this learner now.

INDEX.NAME: questionbankentryid
INDEX.COMMENT: Cohort wide difficulty reporting, and pruning deleted questions.

TABLE.NAME: rememberme_review_log
TABLE.COMMENT: One immutable row per graded attempt. Permits re-tuning the model against real data, retrospective rescheduling, and debugging a drifted scheduler, none of which the live state can support because it carries no history.

FIELD.NAME: questionid
FIELD.COMMENT: The question version actually served, so a teacher can see that an item changed mid course.

FIELD.NAME: rating
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 again, 2 hard, 3 good, 4 easy.

FIELD.NAME: fraction
FIELD.COMMENT: Objective grade, clamped to 0..1 for storage.

FIELD.NAME: elapseddays
FIELD.COMMENT: Effective days since the previous review, with suspended time removed.

FIELD.NAME: latency
FIELD.COMMENT: Milliseconds taken to answer, or null when the measurement was not trustworthy.

FIELD.NAME: insuspension
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether this was voluntary work inside a suspension window.

FIELD.NAME: wasdue
FIELD.COMMENT: The moment this item was due when it was answered, so punctuality can be measured after the fact. Zero for an item that had never come due, such as a first sighting.

INDEX.NAME: userid-qtype
INDEX.COMMENT: Rolling latency medians are per learner and per question type.

TABLE.NAME: rememberme_bands
TABLE.COMMENT: Ordered question categories bound to an instance. Bands gate the introduction of new items, never revision.

FIELD.NAME: sortorder
FIELD.COMMENT: Order within the band. Question difficulty in a syllabus follows the syllabus, not a memory model.

FIELD.NAME: bandnumber
FIELD.COMMENT: Which band this category belongs to, 1 based. Rows sharing a number form one band, so a band can draw on several categories.

TABLE.NAME: rememberme_bandstate
TABLE.COMMENT: Per learner band progress. Unlocking is per learner, so two students in one course can be on different bands.

FIELD.NAME: reason
FIELD.COMMENT: How the current band was reached. A backstop advance is the signal worth acting on.

FIELD.NAME: firstsession
FIELD.COMMENT: Time based unlocking counts from here, not from course start.

FIELD.NAME: bandsince
FIELD.COMMENT: When the current band was entered, for the backstop.

FIELD.NAME: lastunlockwindow
FIELD.COMMENT: Start of the suspension window in which a band last unlocked, enforcing at most one per window.

TABLE.NAME: rememberme_weeks
TABLE.COMMENT: Per learner weekly completion. The target is frozen when the week begins and never grows during it.

FIELD.NAME: snapshottarget
FIELD.COMMENT: Items due at the start of the week plus the new items permitted that week. Never recomputed mid week.

FIELD.NAME: graceapplied
FIELD.COMMENT: Grace spent on this week at final grade calculation.

FIELD.NAME: suspended
FIELD.COMMENT: Weeks more than half suspended are removed from the denominator.

TABLE.NAME: rememberme_suspensions
TABLE.COMMENT: Teacher defined windows during which the scheduling clock does not tick.

TABLE.NAME: rememberme_session
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per delivery session, carrying the question engine usage that renders and grades it.

FIELD.NAME: uniqueid
FIELD.COMMENT: The question_usages id. Core stores no owner on a usage, so the association lives here.

TABLE.NAME: rememberme_slot
TABLE.COMMENT: Which bank entry each question engine slot in a session serves, so a graded slot can be traced back to a schedule record.

FIELD.NAME: isnew
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether this slot introduced a new item, for the per day new item cap.

FIELD.NAME: timeshown
FIELD.COMMENT: Server side render time, so latency is measured server side rather than trusted from the client.
